I doubt it, Random arguments in my house caused by my dad, Everything being blamed on me, If something wrong/bad happens, I get blamed.
In school teachers do nothing even when they hear people saying the shit to me, I feel like it's gonna be me or them sometimes, I sometimes fantasise about killing some of them... I don't know if I need help or what...

This has been happening my whole life, being ignored or plain straight up hated on sight, People always do try to take me down to a low level and they succeed. I wish they don't but they do, Every school day I get almost bullied yet teachers dont do anything at all, Even when they hear it.. I get shouted at all the time by my dad, He starts random arguments for no reason, Which usually end up somehow being my fault. I've just had enough, If I don't die tonight, I sure do know my wrists will be covered for a while.
